result.title: Learning from Another Angle: Rotation-Based Test-Time Training for Multimodal Large Language Models
result.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on vision-language tasks but often remain vulnerable to distribution shifts due to their fixed parameters during inference. While Test-Time Training (TTT) offers a pathway for dynamic adaptation, existing approaches suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to multiple sampling and the risk of error reinforcement from biased self-generated supervision. In light of this view, we propose RoTTT (Rotation-based Test-Time Training), a simple and efficient TTT approach that enables instance-specific refinement at inference time. For each test instance, RoTTT performs a small number of gradient updates by predicting the rotation angle of the input image. The known rotation angles naturally serve as a reliable self-supervised signal, enabling lightweight and stable adaptation without requiring additional annotations. Extensive experiments across multiple vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that RoTTT consistently improves performance across different MLLMs, providing a practical and efficient paradigm for on-the-fly MLLM adaptation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RoTTT：在推理阶段对每个测试样本用少量梯度更新微调 MLLM，自监督信号为预测输入图像的旋转角度；在多个视觉语言基准上验证其能稳定提升不同 MLLM 的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 旋转角作为无需人工标注、可验证的自监督目标，可能为 LVR 中轨迹/状态更新的可靠监督与自生成监督的误差强化问题提供低成本对照线索，但论文未涉及 latent 推理状态，需核查其更新是否触及内部视觉表示。
